question: The author of the novel ‘The Color Purple’ is __________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alice Malsenior Tallulah-Kate Walker** is an American novelist, short story writer, poet, and social activist
 
• In 1982, she became the first African-American woman to win the **Pulitzer Prize for Fiction,** which she was awarded for her novel 'The Color Purple'.
 
• **Meridian, The Colour Purple, To Hell with Dying **are some of her famous work
 
• Her work 'The Color Purple' is the representative announcement of Womanism
 
• Influenced by the background of the African American literature, the black women writer Alice Walker proposed a new concept **Womanism**, which reveals the dual oppression the black women are facing - racial discrimination and sexual discrimination.
